author: Nawafxox
quote: The story is boring, the gameplay is repetitive and easy, and the agendas in the game are disgusting and numerous. It's a shame it's called GTA.

author: Nawafxox
quote: This is my favorite Call of Duty game since Black Ops 3 because the Zombies mode is amazing, and the multiplayer mode is incredibly fun. It features professional gameplay, beautiful maps, and very good weapons. There's also a third mode besides the regular story mode, which is the Endgame mode. I haven't tried it, but I see many people spending time in it, and the concept is fantastic.
